messages.author: 8c434d4aad54fb95
messages.subject: DSsim error
parts:
Hello all, 

I am trying to run simulations using DSsim in R to compare different survey designs and I am getting a weird error when I try to run 2/4 of the simulation objects I have created. I went through the "Survey design simulation case study" by Laura Marshall (very helpful!), but could not find where I am going wrong. I am trying to compare 4 different designs: Random Parallel, Systematic Parallel, Systematic Parallel Segmented Trackline, and Systematic Parallel Segmented Grid. I designed the surveys in the Distance software to generate the necessary shapefiles. Everything went smoothly for the Random Parallel and Systematic Parallel designs, but I am getting this error when I try to run the other two : 

>seg.trackline.sim.run <- run(my.seg.trackline.sim.object)

Error in (function (cl, name, valueClass) : assignment of an object of class “function” is not valid for @‘warnings’ in an object of class “Simulation”; is(value, "list") is not TRUE


I used the same approach for all four designs, so I cannot figure out why the Systematic Parallel Segmented Trackline and Systematic Parallel Segmented Grid are giving this error. Happy to provide more detail about my code if necessary, but perhaps there is something obvious I am missing? 

Thank you in advance for any thoughts and feedback! 

Best,
Elaine

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] DSsim error
parts:
Elaine

Short answer to your question:  DSsim does not have support for segmented transect designs.  This table from ?make.design 

Details

The design.details argument should specify a character vector of either 1 or 2 elements.
Transect Type	Design Details		

Line	Parallel	Systematic

Line	Parallel	Random

Line	Zigzag	Equal Angle

Line	Zigzag	Equal Spaced

Line	User Specified		

Point	Systematic		

Point	Random		

Point	Nested
